text:
deploy-bot: Canary traffic shift started for embed-service @region-us-east: 0% -> 10% (release=redwood-embed v2.4.2). Canary dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/embed/canary

oncall-bot: [ALERT] SLO window: embed-service error_rate 5xx increased above soft-threshold. error_budget remaining: 8% :warning:

sara_ng: seeing it in logs too, a bunch of 502s from model-proxy. p95 latency also up ~120ms

kevin_lee: quick query from infra metrics -> `sum(rate(http_responses_total{service="embed-service",code=~"5.."}[2m]))` shows jump 0.32% -> 1.9% at 3301122300

ian_cheng: copy. Can we hold the rollout? I'm leaning to pin back to v2.4.1 until we triage the proxy change. Thoughts?

maria_seo: thumbs up to hold. This release touched the proxy timeout tweak (shortened keepalive). Might be regressing connections under warmup.

deploy-bot: Received command: `deployctl rollback --service embed-service --to-version v2.4.1 --mode immediate --announce(false)`

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026 (priority=P2) -> assigned: eng-oncall, eng-runtime. Traces: https://traces.internal/redwood/INc-2026

kevin_lee: rolling traffic back now. Also toggling cascade backoff on autoscaler to avoid warmup surge.

deploy-bot: Traffic pinned to v2.4.1 100% (confirmed). Canary paused. Logs for rollback: https://logs.internal/redwood/deploy/3301122334/rollback

sara_ng: I'll grab flamegraphs and model-proxy tcp dumps for the 3301122300-3301122400 window. If it's keepalive, we should be able to repro in staging with headroom tests.

ian_cheng: good. For now no need to escalate to paging. We'll monitor 15m post-pin. If 5xx > 0.8% persist, we'll page.

maria_seo: sending short note to #announcements: "Embed service deploy paused, pinned back to v2.4.1 due to spike in 5xx; working on root cause. Will update in 1h."

kevin_lee: created followup INF-4321: "investigate proxy keepalive timeout interaction with v2.4.2" and added initial traces + query links.

sara_ng: ack. Adding perf markers to the ticket.

deploy-bot: Canary session closed. Final state: rolled back -> v2.4.1 pinned. Canary percent: 10% -> 0%.

ian_cheng: if metrics look stable in 30m we can re-run a controlled canary with instrumentation (tcp dump + slowstart). Otherwise we'll revert the proxy change and repackage.

kevin_lee: noted. Will post a short deploy note in release notes section and tag ops. :white_check_mark:

sara_ng: thanks all. Updating the incident with preliminary timeline and adding next steps.
